skill.name: set-up-magento-chatgpt-ads-customer-matching
skill.description: Set up Magento (Adobe Commerce) customer matching for ChatGPT Ads through Product Metrics and the OpenAI Conversions API. Check tracking prerequisites, configure marketing consent, and verify delivery with a paid test order.
skill.summary: Guide consent-based customer matching for Magento orders in ChatGPT Ads.
skill.author: product-metrics

security_audit.summary: Most static alerts match documentation, setup status checks, or ordinary store operations. The review retained risks involving third-party installs and broad order queries, and identified gaps in credential handling, data-sharing approval, and remote instruction trust. No evidence found of malicious intent or prompt injection directed at the audit.

remediation.issue: The agent workflow allows customers to provide API credentials directly to the assistant.
remediation.suggestion: Remove the credential exception and require entry in the approved vendor form. Prohibit credentials in prompts, tool arguments, logs, and reports.

remediation.issue: Connecting a destination can start sharing identifiers without a separate matching approval step.
remediation.suggestion: Show the merchant the property, pixel, recipients, and hashed and unhashed fields before activation. Require approval and test both granted and denied consent.

remediation.issue: The fallback workflow uses mutable remote documentation as a substitute for reviewed local instructions.
remediation.suggestion: Use versioned bundled references or verify fetched content against a reviewed revision. Require separate approval before remote instructions lead to commands or account changes.

remediation.issue: Test-order verification can retrieve unrelated order records.
remediation.suggestion: Use the test order identifier and the verified store view. Request only the fields required to confirm delivery and redact unrelated order details.

remediation.issue: The workflow relies on third-party skill and Magento module installs.
remediation.suggestion: Verify publisher identity and artifact integrity, pin the installer and source revision, and have a developer review and test the module in staging.

semantic_findings.title: Agent Workflow Can Expose Conversion API Credentials
semantic_findings.description: The workflow permits the assistant to receive an OpenAI Conversions API key and pass it to a command. This can expose the key in conversation records, tool traces, or process arguments, despite the instruction not to log or repeat it.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The agent rule explicitly permits handling the key, while the channel guide tells the merchant never to paste it into chat.

semantic_findings.title: Destination Setup Starts Matching Without a Separate Approval Step
semantic_findings.description: The setup leaves event sending enabled, and eligible events include identifiers automatically. The workflow does not require a separate merchant review of unhashed fields or a test that denied consent suppresses delivery.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The steps show enabled sending, automatic matching, and only an accepted-consent test. They document consent gates, but no evidence found that the workflow tests denial.

semantic_findings.title: Remote Documentation Can Replace Reviewed Workflow Instructions
semantic_findings.description: When local references are missing, the skill directs the assistant to treat live vendor Markdown as the same setup instructions. Changed or compromised content could direct actions outside the reviewed workflow.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The fallback uses unversioned documentation as procedural input and does not require integrity verification. No evidence found that the linked content is compromised.

content.user_title: Set Up Magento Customer Matching for ChatGPT Ads
content.value_statement: Browser cookies alone may leave Magento purchases unmatched in ChatGPT Ads. Use Product Metrics to check tracking and consent settings, then verify delivery with a paid test order.
actual_capabilities: Checks Product Metrics setup status through the CLI or MCP when authenticated access is available.
Identifies the connected Magento store view, linked property, and ChatGPT Ads tracking prerequisites.
Guides merchants through supported consent banner settings and explains which consent choices control event delivery and browser references.
Explains which customer identifiers are hashed and which fields can be sent unhashed.
Guides paid test order verification and explains where to check for delivery errors.
limitations: Requires Product Metrics Pro, editor or admin access on the property, and access to ChatGPT Ads Manager.
A developer must install the Magento module and maintain its scheduled jobs. The merchant completes the store and Ads Manager steps.
Matching starts automatically for eligible events after the destination is connected. There is no separate matching switch or report of the hashed fields.
This skill focuses on matching, not campaign bidding. It does not import historical orders or revise events after later refunds or cancellations.

use_cases.title: Check Matching Readiness
use_cases.description: Confirm whether the Magento store view, Product Metrics property, and ChatGPT Ads pixel are ready before scheduling a test order.

use_cases.title: Review Consent and Data Sharing
use_cases.description: Identify which customer fields can reach ChatGPT Ads and which consent choices apply before approving the destination.

use_cases.title: Diagnose a Missing Test Order
use_cases.description: Check the linked store view and banner settings. Determine whether the test order is missing from Product Metrics or blocked at ads delivery.

prompt_templates.title: List the Prerequisites
prompt_templates.prompt: What do I need before setting up Magento customer matching for ChatGPT Ads? Separate my tasks from the developer's tasks.

prompt_templates.title: Review Consent Settings
prompt_templates.prompt: Show me where to confirm the consent banner in Product Metrics. Explain how marketing, ad storage, and personalization choices affect delivery.

prompt_templates.title: Check Test Order Delivery
prompt_templates.prompt: Help verify delivery for my paid test order in the selected store view. Use its test order ID and do not retrieve unrelated orders.
prompt_templates.scenario: Validating the connection with an approved test order

prompt_templates.title: Review a Production Rollout
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my Magento store view, linked property, and destination without changing settings. List shared fields and propose tests for both granted and denied consent.

output_examples.input: What should I check before connecting ChatGPT Ads?
output: Confirm the Magento store view is active and linked to the intended Product Metrics property.
Check that the developer has installed the Magento module and enabled its scheduled jobs.
Review the consent banner and enter the API key only in the Product Metrics destination form.

output_examples.input: My paid test order was not sent because marketing consent was denied. What should I do?
output: No event should be sent when marketing consent is denied.
If this was a denial test, record the result as expected.
For a delivery test, use a new paid test order with marketing consent and check the OpenAI Conversions API delivery panel.

best_practices: Confirm the store view, Product Metrics property, ads pixel, and fields shared before enabling delivery.
Use the approved destination form for credentials. Do not paste API keys or private Magento configuration files into chat.
Use paid test orders to check both consent granted and consent denied. Report delivery status without exposing customer records.
anti_patterns: Treating the Magento cookie restriction notice as marketing consent.
Assuming all fields are anonymized because some identifiers are hashed.
Using unrelated production orders or including their records in a test report.

faq.question: Which Magento versions are covered?
faq.answer: The guide covers Magento 2.4, Magento 2.0, and Magento 1.9 or OpenMage. A developer installs the appropriate module.

faq.question: Is there a separate customer matching switch?
faq.answer: No. Once the ChatGPT Ads destination is connected, eligible events include matching data automatically.

faq.question: Does Magento's cookie restriction notice count as consent?
faq.answer: No. Select a supported consent banner or have your developer pass visitor choices to Product Metrics. Without marketing consent, the event is not sent.

faq.question: Are all fields hashed?
faq.answer: No. Email, phone, name, and customer ID use SHA-256. Postal code, country, IP address, and user agent can be sent unhashed.

faq.question: Where can I check test order delivery?
faq.answer: Open Tracking, then OpenAI Conversions API, in Product Metrics. Check the connected pixel and delivery status for the paid test order.

faq.question: Can I keep the browser pixel?
faq.answer: Yes. OpenAI deduplicates events when the pixel ID, event name, and event ID match.
